run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if a sorted rotated array has a pair with a given sum
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify pair sum detection correctness
review_f_gold: review f_gold two-pointer algorithm for finding a pair with a given sum in a rotated sorted array
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses a two-pointer approach on a sorted and rotated array to find a target sum pair
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to accept a Python list directly instead of requiring a separate length parameter n
